messages:
Maria: Kicking off sequential rollout for rdx-api v2.3.1 -> US then EU then APAC. Preflight checks now, change window 09:00-11:00 UTC. Ping oncall @Frank and runtime @Kevin.

deploy-bot: Plan created: slices: US 60% -> EU 30% -> APAC 10%; canary per-region 5% traffic; auto-rollback thresholds set (error_rate > 3% or p95 latency +150ms). Details: https://deploys/internal/1876543300

Sam: Confirming: are we pinning APAC to rdx-3b:q4 (quantized) fallback if v2.3.1 shows mem pressure?

Kevin: Yes. APAC will be pinned to rdx-3b:q4 as a compatible fallback. Runtime recommendation: start with batch_size=8 and kv_cache warmup enabled. If we see >70% GPU mem after canary, auto-fallback to pinned model.

Anya: Perf smoke tests running against US slice now. Load generator: 200 rps, 95th latency baseline measurement in progress.

sre-bot: US smoke test results: success. p95=82ms, error_rate=0.12%. GPU util avg=62%.

Jules (product): Noted -- watch output regressions against eval set E2 (prompt subset). If hallucination score increases >5% vs baseline, hold rollout.

Maria: Ok. Rolling to US canary (5%) in 2m. If stable, ramp to 60% over 20m. EU holdpoint at 30% until US 60% green. APAC remains pinned to fallback model until warm pools ready.

deploy-bot: US canary deployed at 1876543420. Traffic slice: 5%. Health checks passing.

Anya: US canary smoke: occasional 500s from one host (host-az3-12). Attaching logs.

Anya: ```
[2026-03-20T09:23:14Z] ERROR inference: OOM when allocating KV cache
[2026-03-20T09:23:14Z] INFO routing: request requeued to host-az3-11
```

Kevin: OOM on single host - taking it out of pool, adjusting batch_size to 6 for canary. Changing autoscale warm_pool +2 nodes in us-west region.

Frank (oncall): Acknowledge. If we see repeated OOMs after batch_size change, trigger rollback to rdx-3b:q4 for that slice and notify customers.

Maria: Making the change now. Command used: ```
redwood deploy update --region us --slice canary --batch_size 6 --kv-warm true
redwood model pin --region apac --model rdx-3b:q4
```

deploy-bot: Update applied. Batch_size=6 for US canary. APAC pinned to rdx-3b:q4.

sre-bot: US canary health: p95=98ms, error_rate=0.25%, GPU util=68%. No further OOMs in last 5m.

Sam: Proceed to ramp US to 60% if no regressions in next 10m. Confirm EU remains at readiness hold.

Jules (product): Eval run against E2 shows hallucination delta +0.8% -- within acceptable range. :white_check_mark:

Maria: Ramping US to 60% over 15m. EU holdpoint remains. APAC warm pools auto-scaling started; target warm nodes: 4.

deploy-bot: US ramp complete at 1876543540. EU canary ready for slice test: 5% if ops gives green.

Kevin: EU capacity check: current reserved GPUs satisfy 30% ramp, but cold start risk in eu-central for quantized variants. Suggest pre-warming 2 nodes and enabling prefix cache.

Frank (oncall): Pre-warm EU nodes now, but pause APAC rollout until warm nodes report healthy. If EU p95 > 200ms during canary, hold and rollback EU slice.

Anya: EU canary smoke started. s3 logs attaching.

sre-bot: EU canary: p95=145ms, error_rate=0.4%, GPU util=71%. Two hosts showing longer tail latencies, digging in.

Maria: Hold EU ramp at 5% until Kevin confirms host tail cause. No APAC changes.

Kevin: Tail due to saturated network NIC on host-eu-07, moving traffic off and increasing connection pool. Will monitor for 10m.

sre-bot: After remediation: EU p95=132ms, error_rate=0.25%. All hosts healthy.

Maria: EU ramp to 30% now. APAC still pinned and waiting for warm_pool=4 healthy. ETA 12m.

deploy-bot: EU ramp to 30% complete at 1876543620.

Frank (oncall): Quick reminder: rollback plan is manual by default with the following command if thresholds tripped: ```
redwood deploy rollback --region <region> --to-model rdx-3b:q4 --reason "auto/ops-trigger"
``` If we rollback, do a one-minute burst test to confirm stability before reattempt.

Maria: APAC warm pools are healthy now (4/4). We'll keep APAC pinned to fallback for initial 10% traffic, then evaluate after 30m. Final check-in in 10m.

Sam: Thanks all. Recording notes for release: change window 09:00-11:00 UTC, pinned fallback for APAC, auto-rollback thresholds as set, observed transient OOM mitigated by batch_size drop.

Jules (product): I'll update the release notes and customer-facing postmortem checklist (if needed).

Frank (oncall): Monitoring hooks and alerts validated. Standing by for any further anomalies.

Maria: Closing thread for now — will open a follow-up if we hit rollback. :rocket:
